page.title: Development environment
page.subtitle: Detected executable paths and versions from this Windows user account.

summary.detail: Executables receive bounded version checks where safe. Command shims and Windows Terminal are detected by path without being invoked; multiple PATH entries are flagged as conflicts.

install.buttonHint: Download and install missing development tools via winget. Windows may show several UAC prompts.
install.confirmMessage: Download and install {{total}} missing development tools with winget ({{tools}})?
install.confirmDetail: Installers run through winget in silent mode. Windows may show several UAC prompts; PATH is refreshed and the environment re-scanned afterwards.
install.allPresent: The development environment is complete — nothing to download.
install.inProgressToast: A download-and-install task is already running.
install.wingetMissing: winget (the Windows package manager) was not found, so the one-click install cannot run.
install.finishedOk: Installed {{installed}} tools; the environment check passed.
install.finishedPartial: Installed {{installed}} tools, {{failed}} failed. Check the logs for details.
install.finishedFailed: The install failed for {{failed}} tools. Check the logs for details.

table.title: Installed development tools
table.stillRunning: The first environment check is still running.

note: Detection only runs version commands for binaries found on PATH. It does not change PATH, install packages or elevate permissions.
